knowledge:
- key_parameters: n=specifies which alternate allele to retrieve in altChar (e.g., n=1 or n=2 for multi-allelic sites) ;; margin=specifies whether to calculate metrics "by.variant" or "by.sample" in missingGenotypeRate, heterozygosity, and inbreedCoeff ;; model.type=specifies the regression model type ("linear", "logistic", or "firth") in regression ;; variantBlock=number of variants to include in each block for SeqVarBlockIterator ;; windowSize=size of genomic windows in base pairs for SeqVarWindowIterator ;; windowShift=step size of genomic windows in base pairs for SeqVarWindowIterator
- alternatives: SNPRelate and GENESIS for determining relatedness and population structure ;; GENESIS for aggregate association tests
- when_to_use: Appropriate when analyzing large-scale sequencing datasets (VCF format) to perform quality control checks (TiTv, HWE, heterozygosity, Mendelian errors), run single-variant association tests, or process data in memory-efficient chunks using iterators.
- pitfalls: Using character strings for variant.id instead of integers (via setVariantID) may decrease performance for large datasets ;; Ensure new variant IDs are unique before renaming them using setVariantID ;; Firth regression (model.type="firth") is recommended over standard logistic regression for rare variants to avoid issues with separation/convergence.

workflows.name: variant_qc_and_association_testing
workflows.intent: Convert VCF to GDS, perform variant quality control checks (TiTv, heterozygosity, PCA, HWE, Mendelian errors), and run single-variant association tests.
workflows.stages: 1. Convert VCF to GDS format using seqVCF2GDS and open it with seqOpen ;; 2. Extract basic variant info (alleles, SNV status, coordinates) and optionally rename variant IDs with setVariantID ;; 3. Calculate QC metrics: TiTv ratio (titv), missing genotype rate (missingGenotypeRate), heterozygosity (heterozygosity), and filter variants using seqSetFilter ;; 4. Perform population structure analysis via PCA (pca) and test for Hardy-Weinberg Equilibrium (hwe) ;; 5. Check for Mendelian errors using pedigree data (mendelErr) ;; 6. Combine GDS and sample annotation into a SeqVarData object and run single-variant association tests using regression.
workflows.code:
library(SeqVarTools)
vcffile <- seqExampleFileName("vcf")
gdsfile <- "tmp.gds"
seqVCF2GDS(vcffile, gdsfile, verbose=FALSE)
gds <- seqOpen(gdsfile)
gds
head(refChar(gds))
head(altChar(gds))
table(nAlleles(gds))
multi.allelic <- which(nAlleles(gds) > 2)
altChar(gds)[multi.allelic]
altChar(gds, n=1)[multi.allelic]
altChar(gds, n=2)[multi.allelic]
table(isSNV(gds))
isSNV(gds)[multi.allelic]
head(seqGetData(gds, "chromosome"))
head(seqGetData(gds, "position"))
granges(gds)
head(seqGetData(gds, "sample.id"))
head(seqGetData(gds, "variant.id"))
rsID <- seqGetData(gds, "annotation/id")
head(rsID)
length(unique(rsID)) == length(rsID)
seqClose(gds)
setVariantID(gdsfile, rsID)
gds <- seqOpen(gdsfile)
head(seqGetData(gds, "variant.id"))
geno <- getGenotype(gds)
dim(geno)
geno[1:10, 1:5]
geno <- getGenotypeAlleles(gds)
geno[1:10, 1:5]
samp.id <- seqGetData(gds, "sample.id")[1:10]
var.id <- seqGetData(gds, "variant.id")[1:5]
applyMethod(gds, getGenotype, variant=var.id, sample=samp.id)
library(GenomicRanges)
gr <- GRanges(seqnames="22", IRanges(start=1, end=250000000))
geno <- applyMethod(gds, getGenotype, variant=gr)
dim(geno)
titv(gds)
head(titv(gds, by.sample=TRUE))
binVar <- function(var, names, breaks) {
  names(var) <- names
  var <- sort(var)
  mids <- breaks[1:length(breaks)-1] + 
    (breaks[2:length(breaks)] - breaks[1:length(breaks)-1])/2
  bins <- cut(var, breaks, labels=mids, right=FALSE)
  split(names(var), bins)
}
variant.id <- seqGetData(gds, "variant.id")
afreq <- alleleFrequency(gds)
maf <- pmin(afreq, 1-afreq)
maf.bins <- binVar(maf, variant.id, seq(0,0.5,0.02))
nbins <- length(maf.bins)
titv.maf <- rep(NA, nbins)
for (i in 1:nbins) {
  capture.output(titv.maf[i] <- applyMethod(gds, titv, variant=maf.bins[[i]]))
}
plot(as.numeric(names(maf.bins)), titv.maf, xlab="MAF", ylab="TiTv")
miss <- missingGenotypeRate(gds)
miss.bins <- binVar(miss, variant.id, c(seq(0,0.5,0.05),1))
nbins <- length(miss.bins)
titv.miss <- rep(NA, nbins)
for (i in 1:nbins) {
  capture.output(titv.miss[i] <- applyMethod(gds, titv, variant=miss.bins[[i]]))
}
plot(as.numeric(names(miss.bins)), titv.miss, xlab="missing rate", ylab="TiTv")
depth <- seqApply(gds, "annotation/format/DP", mean, margin="by.variant", 
                  as.is="double", na.rm=TRUE)
depth.bins <- binVar(depth, variant.id, seq(0,200,20))
nbins <- length(depth.bins)
titv.depth <- rep(NA, nbins)
for (i in 1:nbins) {
  capture.output(titv.depth[i] <- applyMethod(gds, titv, variant=depth.bins[[i]]))
}
plot(as.numeric(names(depth.bins)), titv.depth, xlab="mean depth", ylab="TiTv")
miss.var <- missingGenotypeRate(gds, margin="by.variant")
het.var <- heterozygosity(gds, margin="by.variant")
filt <- seqGetData(gds, "variant.id")[miss.var <= 0.1 & het.var <= 0.6]
seqSetFilter(gds, variant.id=filt)
hethom <- hethom(gds)
hist(hethom, main="", xlab="Het/Hom Non-Ref")
seqSetFilter(gds)
pc <- pca(gds)
names(pc)
plot(pc$eigenvect[,1], pc$eigenvect[,2])
hw <- hwe(gds)
pval <- -log10(sort(hw$p))
hw.perm <- hwe(gds, permute=TRUE)
x <- -log10(sort(hw.perm$p))
plot(x, pval, xlab="-log10(expected P)", ylab="-log10(observed P)")	
abline(0,1,col="red")
hist(hw$f)
ic <- inbreedCoeff(gds, margin="by.sample")
range(ic)
data(pedigree)
pedigree[pedigree$family == 1463,]
err <- mendelErr(gds, pedigree, verbose=FALSE)
table(err$by.variant)
err$by.trio
library(Biobase)
sample.id <- seqGetData(gds, "sample.id")
pedigree <- pedigree[match(sample.id, pedigree$sample.id),]
n <- length(sample.id)
pedigree$phenotype <- rnorm(n, mean=10)
pedigree$case.status <- rbinom(n, 1, 0.3)
sample.data <- AnnotatedDataFrame(pedigree)
seqData <- SeqVarData(gds, sample.data)
assoc <- regression(seqData, outcome="phenotype", covar="sex",
                    model.type="linear")
head(assoc)
pval <- -log10(sort(assoc$Wald.Pval))
n <- length(pval)
x <- -log10((1:n)/n)
plot(x, pval, xlab="-log10(expected P)", ylab="-log10(observed P)")
abline(0, 1, col = "red")
assoc <- regression(seqData, outcome="case.status", covar="sex",
                    model.type="firth")
head(assoc)
pval <- -log10(sort(assoc$PPL.Pval))
n <- length(pval)
x <- -log10((1:n)/n)
plot(x, pval, xlab="-log10(expected P)", ylab="-log10(observed P)")
abline(0, 1, col = "red")
seqClose(gds)
unlink(gdsfile)

workflows.name: iterative_variant_processing
workflows.intent: Use block, range, window, or list iterators to process large genomic datasets in memory-efficient chunks.
workflows.stages: 1. Open GDS file and wrap it in a SeqVarData object ;; 2. Initialize an iterator (SeqVarBlockIterator, SeqVarRangeIterator, SeqVarWindowIterator, or SeqVarListIterator) ;; 3. Loop through chunks using iterateFilter and extract variant information with variantInfo ;; 4. Reset the iterator if needed using resetIterator.
workflows.code:
library(SeqVarTools)
gds <- seqOpen(seqExampleFileName("gds"))
seqData <- SeqVarData(gds)
iterator <- SeqVarBlockIterator(seqData, variantBlock=500)
var.info <- list(variantInfo(iterator))
i <- 2
while(iterateFilter(iterator)) {
    var.info[[i]] <- variantInfo(iterator)
    i <- i + 1
}
lapply(var.info, head)
seqResetFilter(seqData)
seqSetFilter(seqData, variant.sel=1:100)
iterator <- SeqVarBlockIterator(seqData, variantBlock=500)
var.info <- variantInfo(iterator)
nrow(var.info)
iterateFilter(iterator)
seqResetFilter(seqData)
library(GenomicRanges)
gr <- GRanges(seqnames=rep(1,3), 
              ranges=IRanges(start=c(1e6, 2e6, 3e6), width=1e6))
iterator <- SeqVarRangeIterator(seqData, variantRanges=gr)
var.info <- list(variantInfo(iterator))
i <- 2
while(iterateFilter(iterator)) {
    var.info[[i]] <- variantInfo(iterator)
    i <- i + 1
}
lapply(var.info, head)
seqResetFilter(seqData)
seqSetFilterChrom(seqData, include="22")
iterator <- SeqVarWindowIterator(seqData, windowSize=10000, 
                                 windowShift=5000)
var.info <- list(variantInfo(iterator))
i <- 2
while(iterateFilter(iterator)) {
    var.info[[i]] <- variantInfo(iterator)
    i <- i + 1
}
lapply(var.info, head)
seqResetFilter(seqData)
gr <- GRangesList(
  GRanges(seqnames=rep(22,2), 
          ranges=IRanges(start=c(16e6, 17e6), width=1e6)),
  GRanges(seqnames=rep(22,2), 
          ranges=IRanges(start=c(18e6, 20e6), width=1e6)))
iterator <- SeqVarListIterator(seqData, variantRanges=gr)
var.info <- list(variantInfo(iterator))
i <- 2
while(iterateFilter(iterator)) {
    var.info[[i]] <- variantInfo(iterator)
    i <- i + 1
}
lapply(var.info, head)
variantInfo(iterator)
resetIterator(iterator)
variantInfo(iterator)
seqClose(gds)
